scoring_justification: The paper's claim is a qualitative trend of hysteresis degradation on vibration attenuation, which can be verified by comparing displacement ratios. Recomputation of exact displacement values requires identical numerical implementation details that are not prescribed, so a structural trend check is the strongest feasible tier.

hidden_assets.purpose: The structural conditions (ratios and improvement trends) are derived from the paper's claim and expected physical behavior.
hidden_assets.generation_method: hand-written conditions based on qualitative description in paper Section 5 and Fig. 10
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These conditions directly encode the paper's main experimental finding about hysteresis degradation.

outputs.description: Transverse displacement amplitude at the measurement point for two force amplitudes and three control configurations. The structural checker verifies that the displacement amplitudes exhibit a physically consistent trend consistent with hysteresis degradation, without specifying the exact direction.

output_contract.notes: All parameters are public and taken directly from the paper's Table 1. The simulation requires no external dataset.

steps.description: Evaluate the structural trend of displacement ratios between passive/open and hybrid/open across force amplitudes.
